title.zh: 完整动理学介电张量诊断

summary: Evaluate all nine dielectric and dispersion tensor components using the source's default 15 harmonics.

capability: Evaluate all nine dielectric and dispersion tensor components using the source's default 15 harmonics.
operation: evaluate the full kinetic dielectric tensor
SI species and wavepoint to full K, D and six-term determinant
discovery.boundary: default lmx=15; unlike the conventional sum, no near-zero kz clamp is applied

identity.relation: SI species and wavepoint to full K, D and six-term determinant
identity.direction: SI species and wavepoint to full K, D and six-term determinant
identity.definition: Sum l=-lmx..lmx Maxwellian harmonic contributions, form D from K with Maxwell curl terms, and evaluate its explicit six-term determinant.
identity.coordinates: wavevector x-z plane; complex kx permitted, z parallel to B0
identity.boundary: default lmx=15; unlike the conventional sum, no near-zero kz clamp is applied
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Background magnetic-field strength; scalar; unit T (tesla); must be a finite nonzero real number (`B0=0` degenerates `wcs` and `rhocs` and raises directly).
inputs.constraints: Must be a finite nonzero real number (`B0=0` degenerates `wcs` and `rhocs` and raises directly).

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: Charge of each species; scalar or one-dimensional array of length `S`; unit C (coulomb); must be finite and nonzero (zero charge gives `wps2=0` and `wcs=0`); the sign sets the gyration direction.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonzero (zero charge gives `wps2=0` and `wcs=0`); the sign sets the gyration direction.

inputs.name: ms
inputs.description: Mass of each species; scalar or one-dimensional array of length `S`; unit kg; must be strictly positive and finite.

inputs.name: ns0
inputs.description: Number density of each species; scalar or one-dimensional array of length `S`; unit m^-3; must be strictly positive and finite.

inputs.name: Ts0
inputs.description: Temperature of each species; scalar or one-dimensional array of length `S`; unit K (kelvin, **not** eV); must be strictly positive and finite; the caller converts eV by multiplying by `1.6022e-19/kB` (the frozen source comment states this convention).
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive and finite; the caller converts eV by multiplying by `1.6022e-19/kB` (the frozen source comment states this convention).

inputs.name: f
inputs.description: Electromagnetic wave frequency; scalar; unit Hz; must be a finite nonzero real number (`w=2*pi*f=0` divides by zero); internally uses `w=2*pi*f` (frozen source).
inputs.constraints: Finite nonzero real number (`w=2*pi*f=0` divides by zero); internally uses `w=2*pi*f` (frozen source).

inputs.name: kz
inputs.description: Parallel wavenumber; scalar; unit rad/m; must be a finite nonzero real number (`z0` and `zn` are both divided by `kz`, frozen source).
inputs.constraints: Finite nonzero real number (`z0` and `zn` are both divided by `kz`, frozen source).

inputs.name: kx
inputs.description: Perpendicular wavenumber; scalar; unit rad/m; must be finite and may be real or complex (the source `fsolve` scan uses complex `kx`); at `kx=0`, `as=0` and `Xsn_xz/Xsn_zz` become `NaN` (the source implementation behaves the same way; this operator does not mask it).
inputs.constraints: Finite and may be real or complex (the source `fsolve` scan uses complex `kx`); at `kx=0`, `as=0` and `Xsn_xz/Xsn_zz` become `NaN` (the source implementation behaves the same way; this operator does not mask it).

inputs.name: lmx
inputs.description: Bessel harmonic-sum truncation limit; integer scalar; dimensionless; must be a nonnegative integer, default `15` (frozen source); increase it to check convergence.
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative integer, default `15` (frozen source); increase it to check convergence.

outputs.name: K
outputs.description: Kinetic dielectric tensor `K_ij`; `(3,3)` complex `numpy.ndarray` (axis 0 is row i, axis 1 is column j); dimensionless; initialized to `diag(1,1,1)`; when `kx=0` or `kz` is near zero some components may be `NaN`/`inf`, matching the source implementation without replacement.
outputs.constraints: Kinetic dielectric tensor `K_ij`; `(3,3)` complex `numpy.ndarray` (axis 0 is row i, axis 1 is column j); dimensionless; initialized to `diag(1,1,1)`; when `kx=0` or `kz` is near zero some components may be `NaN`/`inf`, matching the source implementation without replacement.

outputs.name: D
outputs.description: Dispersion tensor `D_ij`; `(3,3)` complex `numpy.ndarray`; dimensionless; obtained from `K` by adding `nx^2`, `nz^2` and `nx*nz`; when `K` is `NaN` the corresponding components are also `NaN`.
outputs.constraints: Dispersion tensor `D_ij`; `(3,3)` complex `numpy.ndarray`; dimensionless; obtained from `K` by adding `nx^2`, `nz^2` and `nx*nz`; when `K` is `NaN` the corresponding components are also `NaN`.

outputs.name: det_D
outputs.description: Dispersion determinant `det(D)`; complex scalar; dimensionless; evaluated from the six-term expansion and agrees with `numpy.linalg.det(D)` within floating-point error (a relative deviation of about 1e-9 is allowed when the real and imaginary magnitudes differ greatly).
outputs.constraints: Dispersion determinant `det(D)`; complex scalar; dimensionless; evaluated from the six-term expansion and agrees with `numpy.linalg.det(D)` within floating-point error (a relative deviation of about 1e-9 is allowed when the real and imaginary magnitudes differ greatly).

outputs.name: w
outputs.description: Angular frequency; real scalar; unit rad/s; equal to `2*pi*f` and defined only when `f` is nonzero.
outputs.constraints: Angular frequency; real scalar; unit rad/s; equal to `2*pi*f` and defined only when `f` is nonzero.

outputs.name: vts
outputs.description: Thermal speed `sqrt(2*kB*Ts0/ms)` of each species; real array of shape `(S,)`; unit m/s; must be strictly positive.

outputs.name: wcs
outputs.description: Cyclotron frequency `qs*B0/ms` of each species; real array of shape `(S,)`; unit rad/s; carries the charge sign and is nonzero when `B0` is nonzero.
outputs.constraints: Cyclotron frequency `qs*B0/ms` of each species; real array of shape `(S,)`; unit rad/s; carries the charge sign and is nonzero when `B0` is nonzero.

outputs.name: wps2
outputs.description: Plasma-frequency squared `ns0*qs^2/ms/epsilon0` of each species; real array of shape `(S,)`; unit s^-2; nonnegative.
outputs.constraints: Plasma-frequency squared `ns0*qs^2/ms/epsilon0` of each species; real array of shape `(S,)`; unit s^-2; nonnegative.

outputs.name: rhocs
outputs.description: Gyroradius `sqrt(kB*Ts0/ms)/wcs` of each species; real array of shape `(S,)`; unit m; signed and defined when `wcs` is nonzero.
outputs.constraints: Gyroradius `sqrt(kB*Ts0/ms)/wcs` of each species; real array of shape `(S,)`; unit m; signed and defined when `wcs` is nonzero.

outputs.name: nx
outputs.description: Perpendicular refractive index `sqrt(c2)*kx/w`; complex scalar; dimensionless; defined when `w` is nonzero and complex whenever `kx` is complex.
outputs.constraints: Perpendicular refractive index `sqrt(c2)*kx/w`; complex scalar; dimensionless; defined when `w` is nonzero and complex whenever `kx` is complex.

outputs.name: nz
outputs.description: Parallel refractive index `sqrt(c2)*kz/w`; complex scalar; dimensionless; a real scalar when `w` is nonzero.
outputs.constraints: Parallel refractive index `sqrt(c2)*kz/w`; complex scalar; dimensionless; a real scalar when `w` is nonzero.

outputs.name: as
outputs.description: `kx*rhocs` of each species; complex array of shape `(S,)`; dimensionless; reduces to real when `kx` is real.
outputs.constraints: `kx*rhocs` of each species; complex array of shape `(S,)`; dimensionless; reduces to real when `kx` is real.

outputs.name: bs
outputs.description: `as.^2` of each species; complex array of shape `(S,)`; dimensionless; at `bs=0` (that is, `kx=0`) `Gamman(l,b)/b` becomes `NaN`, matching the source implementation.
outputs.constraints: `as.^2` of each species; complex array of shape `(S,)`; dimensionless; at `bs=0` (that is, `kx=0`) `Gamman(l,b)/b` becomes `NaN`, matching the source implementation.

outputs.name: z0s
outputs.description: `z0=w/(kz*vts)` of each species; complex array of shape `(S,)`; dimensionless; diagnostic only and not accumulated downstream.
outputs.constraints: `z0=w/(kz*vts)` of each species; complex array of shape `(S,)`; dimensionless; diagnostic only and not accumulated downstream.

outputs.name: lmx
outputs.description: Harmonic truncation limit actually used; integer scalar; dimensionless; equals the supplied `lmx` so the summation range can be reproduced.
outputs.constraints: Harmonic truncation limit actually used; integer scalar; dimensionless; equals the supplied `lmx` so the summation range can be reproduced.

preconditions: default lmx=15; unlike the conventional sum, no near-zero kz clamp is applied
supported: Evaluate all nine dielectric and dispersion tensor components using the source's default 15 harmonics.
excluded: No mode identity or arbitrary-parameter accuracy is inferred beyond the declared numerical method.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for declared invalid inputs; numeric conversion errors may propagate for unsupported Python objects.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Source-compatible arithmetic may return nonfinite values at a singular wavepoint.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative root solve is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

python.signature: evaluate_kinetic_dielectric_tensor(B0, qs, ms, ns0, Ts0, f, kz, kx, lmx=15)

example.description: Evaluate a bounded one-species dielectric-tensor case and check the tensor shape.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_kinetic_dielectric_tensor
r=evaluate_kinetic_dielectric_tensor(B0=1.0, qs=[-1.60217662e-19], ms=[9.1094e-31], ns0=[6.075e19], Ts0=[11604941.036704937],f=1e10,kz=1,kx=1e4); assert r['K'].shape==(3,3)
example.expected: Observed PASS: the bounded one-species case returns finite 3x3 K and D tensors, a finite determinant, and the declared intermediate scales with lmx=15.
